# Third-party font sources

`instrument-serif-*.woff2` and `manrope-*.woff2` are redistributed here in
derived (WOFF2, subsetted-by-upstream) form under the terms of their
license.

- **Instrument Serif** — designed by Instrument. OFL-1.1 License.
  https://github.com/Instrument/instrument-serif
- **Manrope** — designed by Mikhail Sharanda. OFL-1.1 License.
  https://github.com/sharanda/manrope

Fetched via `npm pack @fontsource/instrument-serif @fontsource/manrope`
(the npm registry, not a live CDN) — see `fonts.css` and
`css/mini-apps.css` for how they're used.
